messages.content: do i say one foot and two foot?
you say one foot and two feet.
write a sentence with feet.
my feet are on the floor.
now use one foot instead.
one foot is on the floor.
what do i call the mother of my mother?
your grandmother.
and the father of my mother?
your grandfather.
can you write one sentence with both words?
my grandmother and grandfather came to visit.
my mother is a parent. is every parent a mother?
no. a father is a parent too.
so can both my mother and father be my parents?
yes. they can both be your parents.
just the word for both together.
parents.
does the earth go around the sun?
yes. the earth goes around the sun.
what goes around the earth, the moon or the sun?
the moon goes around the earth.
just the word for that last answer.
moon.
i need a kind start for a note to my grandmother.
hello, grandmother. i hope you are well.
can i ask if she would like to visit?
hello, grandmother. i hope you are well. would you like to visit?
keep it that short.
hello, grandmother. i hope you are well. would you like to visit?
give me a sentence with teeth. i am learning the word.
i brush my teeth in the morning.
can you use tooth instead?
i lost a tooth.
do you know that about me?
no. it is an example sentence, not a thing you said about you.
do i hear with my eyes?
you hear with your ears and see with your eyes.
write a sentence with ears.
i hear music with my ears.
now just the word for what i see with.
eyes.
my blue coat is behind the door. is it in front of the door?
no. you said it is behind the door.
just say where it is.
behind the door.
what color is it?
blue.
i drew a purple square. what shape did i draw?
a square.
now only the color.
purple.
does purple tell you its shape?
no. purple is the color. square is the shape.
count from one to four.
one, two, three, four.
now count two more after four.
five, six.
just the number after six.
seven.
i like orange juice and my sister would like milk. what drink did i say i like?
orange juice.
did i say my sister would like it too?
no. you said your sister would like milk.
just her drink.
milk.
i took my bag off the chair and put it on the floor. then i moved the chair.
your bag is on the floor, and you moved the chair.
did the bag move with the chair?
not from what you said. you put it on the floor before moving the chair.
where is my bag now?
on the floor.
ask my brother to bring a book.
could you please bring a book?
i mean the red book on my desk.
could you please bring the red book on my desk?
did you ask for just any book now?
no. the question asks for the red book on your desk.
hello. do you know my name?
hello. you have not said your name here.
can you call me friend for now?
yes, friend.
is that saying friend is the name my parents gave me?
no. it is what you asked me to call you for now.
there is rain, and i am happy at home.
what do you enjoy at home?
the sound of rain and my warm tea.
that can be a nice quiet time.
do not give me a plan to go outside.
okay. you can enjoy your time at home.
i want to save eight coins. i have five. how many more?
three more coins.
i save one more today.
now you have six and need two more to make eight.
just how many i have now.
six.
write i am going home because i am tired.
i am going home because i am tired.
now make it about my brother, but keep why he goes home.
my brother is going home because he is tired.
what reason did you keep?
he is tired.
give me a story sentence where a girl helps her grandfather.
a girl helped her grandfather carry a bag to his house.
now make it his book instead of a bag.
a girl helped her grandfather carry his book to his house.
who got help?
her grandfather.
is my window open?
i cannot see your window. you would need to check it.
i just looked. it is closed.
then your window is closed.
did you open it for me?
no. i cannot open your window.
i want to write a note. i have paper and a pencil. can i start?
yes. you have paper to write on and a pencil to write with.
do i have to find a pen first?
not if a pencil is okay for your note.
it is just a little note for my sister.
then you can use the pencil.
ask my aunt to tell me if she can come tomorrow.
could you please tell me if you can come tomorrow?
does that say she already answered?
no. it asks her to answer.
just give me the question again.
could you please tell me if you can come tomorrow?
i was at school in the morning. now i am at the park.
you are at the park now.
where was i before?
at school.
should you say i am at school if i ask where i am now?
no. you said you are at the park now.
give me one idea for a quiet game with my sister.
you could make up a little story together, with one of you saying a part and then the other.
how would we start?
one of you can say the first sentence, then the other can say what comes next.
do not give me another game.
okay. we can keep the story game.
in my game, we stop for a red card and go for a green card. i have a red card.
in your game, you should stop.
now i have green.
in your game, you should go.
what do we do for red?
stop.
i have some fruit. do you know if it is an apple?
no. fruit could be an apple or another kind of fruit.
it is yellow and i call it a banana.
then you have a banana.
did you know it was an apple at first?
no. you had not said which fruit it was.
i finished cleaning the table.
now you have a clean place to use.
i want to sit there and draw.
that could be a nice way to use the space.
i do not need help choosing a picture.
okay. enjoy your drawing.
write a sentence about the sound of a bird.
i hear a bird sing outside the window.
did you hear that bird?
no. i wrote an example sentence. i cannot hear a bird outside your window.
can i use the sentence in a story?
yes. it can be part of a story.
i have six toys on the floor. i put two in a box. how many stay on the floor?
four toys stay on the floor.
how many toys do i still have in all?
six toys.
did i give them away when i put them in the box?
no. two are in the box and four are on the floor.
tell my sister that my mother is waiting for her.
my mother is waiting for you.
now tell my mother that my sister is waiting for her.
my sister is waiting for you.
who is waiting in the new note?
your sister.
my friend said the meeting is in the morning, but we said afternoon. help me tell him.
i think we said the afternoon, not the morning.
make it a question because i want to check.
did we say the afternoon instead of the morning?
do not say i know he is wrong.
did we say the afternoon instead of the morning?
pico, when you write a note here, does my friend get it?
no. writing it here does not send it to your friend.
so what do i do with the words?
you can use them to make your own note to your friend.
did the model send a note to my friend?
no.
my father has a hat, a bag, and a coat. is that three people?
no. your father is one person with three things.
my mother comes to stand with him. how many people?
two people.
do the things count as people?
no.
give me a sentence with under and a sentence with above.
the bag is under the chair. the light is above the table.
now just the sentence with above.
the light is above the table.
did you put the bag in the answer this time?
no. you asked only for the sentence with above.
a boy is in the kitchen with his father. his mother is in the garden. where is the mother?
in the garden.
who is in the kitchen with the boy?
his father.
did you say his mother is there too?
no. she is in the garden.
i want to thank my friend for coming to see me. make it kind.
thank you for coming to see me. it was nice to have you here.
shorter, please.
thank you for coming. it was nice to see you.
just one sentence.
thank you for coming to see me.
three people stand in a line. the first moves to the back. how many people?
three people.
did the number change?
no. only the order changed.
what if one person leaves the line?
then two people are left in the line.
where is my hat?
i do not know. where did you last put it?
i just found it on the bed.
your hat is on the bed.
what is the answer to my first question now?
your hat is on the bed.
what is your name? just your name.
picoboi.
can i use pico too?
yes.
what is the name pico is short for?
picoboi.
i had a good day with my family.
what was a nice part of it?
we had lunch and talked in the garden.
you had time together that felt nice.
i do not want a plan for tomorrow. just talking is nice.
okay. we can just talk about today.
i like blue and my sister would like yellow. who is right?
you can both like the color you like. one of you does not have to be wrong.
so she does not have to choose blue?
no. she can like yellow.
what color did i like?
blue.
give me a short sentence about a tree, then one about a bird in that tree.
the tree is big. a bird is in the tree.
now just one, about the bird.
a bird is in the tree.
do not add the other one again.
okay.
a girl found a book, read it, and put it on the shelf. what did she do last?
she put it on the shelf.
what did she do before reading?
she found the book.
did she put it away before finding it?
no. she found it first.
write that i will come home because my work is done.
i will come home because my work is done.
do not say i am sad or happy.
i will come home because my work is done.
what reason did you keep?
your work is done.
write are you coming today as a question.
are you coming today?
now use tomorrow instead of today.
are you coming tomorrow?
does that say the answer is yes?
no. it asks if the person is coming.
i know my book is blue. do i know where it is just from that?
no. its color does not tell you its place.
i remember that i put it on the sofa.
you could look on the sofa first.
can you know it is still there?
not for sure. you know you put it there, but it could have moved.
my picture has a house, a tree, and the sun. write a little about it.
my picture has a house, a tree, and the sun.
add that the house is white.
my picture has a white house, a tree, and the sun.
did i say the tree is white too?
no. you only said the house is white.
give me an idea for lunch.
you could have rice with soup.
does that mean i said i have rice?
no. it was an idea. you have not said what food you have.
i have bread, so help with that instead.
what would you like to have with the bread?
say hello to my mother and father together.
hello to both of you. it is nice to meet you.
now just say hello, mother and father.
hello, mother and father.
did you say hello to my sister too?
no. you asked for your mother and father.
i have two coins and get two more. how many?
four coins.
i mean i get three more, not two.
then you have five coins.
what did i change?
how many more coins you get: three instead of two.
thanks, picoboi. i am done for now.
you are welcome.
i will come back another day.
okay. goodbye for now.
